description: Source code for handling triggers and interrupts for the Bosch BMM150 pressure sensor in Zephyr OS, including thread management, GPIO callbacks, and trigger setup functions.

methods.name: bmm150_handle_interrupts
methods.description: Handles the BMM150 interrupt by invoking the registered data-ready handler if set.

methods.name: bmm150_thread_main
methods.description: Main function for the dedicated thread to handle interrupts when using own thread configuration.

methods.name: bmm150_work_handler
methods.description: Work handler for global thread trigger handling.

methods.name: bmm150_gpio_callback
methods.description: GPIO callback invoked on interrupt, triggers appropriate handling based on configuration.

methods.name: bmm150_trigger_set
methods.description: Configures the data-ready trigger and enables the corresponding interrupt.

methods.name: bmm150_trigger_mode_init
methods.description: Initializes trigger mode, including thread setup and GPIO configuration.
